name: @wae/open-viewer-workspace
description: OpenViewer workspace: image decode, metadata, and thumbnails

scripts.build:ui: pnpm --filter @wae/open-viewer-ui run build && pnpm --filter @wae/open-viewer-ui run stage
scripts.build: pnpm run build:napi && pnpm run build:ts && pnpm run build:ui
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace
scripts.gui: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @wae/open-viewer exec node ./dist/cli.js gui
